jobs.employer_name: KONGSBERG MARITIME AS AVD LYSAKER TORG K-SIM
jobs.description:
About Falkor
We build industrial intelligence software for heavy-asset sectors. As a KONGSBERG company backed by over 200 years of heritage, Falkor helps the energy, chemicals, utilities and other industrial sectors operate with absolute clarity, confidence, and control.

Our AI-enabled platform connects people, systems, and workflows—expanding human capability by turning complex data into real-time, actionable decisions. We help leading organizations improve safety, efficiency and performance while redefining how heavy assets are designed and operated.
Team  
Falkor has a long history of delivering world class dynamic simulators (K-Spice and LedaFlow) to multiple industries for Engineering, Operator Training and Real-time decision support. The traditional market area is Oil & Gas but we see an increasing use of our technology in the Net Zero domain e.g. Carbon Capture and Storage. We are also integrating with our industrial worksurface called Kognitwin which is taking traditional on-premise simulators into the Cloud.   
Responsibilities 
The Growth Manager will be responsible for growing the Energy Simulation business in EMEA. This is a mature business but the focus will be to secure new logos for Falkor and to upsell and cross sell to existing customers. Key areas of responsibility include:   

• 
Pro-actively seek new opportunities for Energy Simulation. 

• 
Establish and maintain a good understanding of customer challenges and how Falkor can be positioned to meet these challenges  

• 
Maximise and secure Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in a timely manner 

• 
Identify upselling opportunities to existing customers and simulator deliveries 

• 
Collaborate with Falkor Surface Growth to identify opportunities to deploy Falkor Surface Simulation 

• 
Work closely with our Product and Marketing team to position Energy Simulation and build value propositions 

• 
Lead bid processes for our Energy Simulation offering and support larger deals where Energy Simulation is a component of Falkor Surface

• 
Accurately manage leads, opportunities and recurring revenue in CRM 

• 
Identify, and propose any improvements related to procedures, working methods and tools. 

• 
Performance of all work according to the working methods set out in the Falkor Business Management System (BMS) 

• 
Comply with all standards established within Kongsberg Gruppen (KOG)/Falkor

Qualifications and Skills   
• 
Bachelor or Master’s degree in relevant technical fields 

• 
Fluent in English 

• 
Strong sales experience and domain knowledge from the Energy industry; preferably Process Simulation or Flow Assurance 

• 
Self-driven person with positive attitude and good cooperative skills 

• 
Communicate clearly and concisely with diverse audiences, in both oral and written contexts, and  giving and receiving feedback.  

• 
Leadership and interpersonal skills, communication, negotiation, conflict resolution, persuasion etc. 

Why join Falkor?
You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate.

At Falkor, you'll have the opportunity to:

• 
Work on meaningful challenges with real-world impact

• 
Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains

• 
Learn from experts in software, engineering, operations, and digital transformation

• 
Grow your career in a business that is expanding globally

• 
Help shape technology that expands human capability in complex industries

We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work.

Ready to apply?
If you're excited about solving complex challenges and making an impact through technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your resume.

Agency notice

Falkor occasionally partners with selected recruitment agencies for specific hiring requirements. We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions and will not be responsible for associated fees unless terms have been agreed in advance through our Procurement team.

Om arbeidsgiveren:
At Kongsberg Digital, our mission is to transform the world’s most complex and asset-intensive industries through world-leading, AI-powered digital twin technology. 
 

As a pioneer in industrial digitalization, we provide a comprehensive suite of software solutions that empower organizations to manage the full lifecycle of their assets—more efficiently, safely, and sustainably than ever before. 

The industry is on the cusp of a digital revolution—and we’re leading the charge. From early adoption of AI to building trusted partnerships with some of the world’s largest industrial players, we are redefining how work gets done. With domain expertise baked into every line of code and a high-calibre team united by a clear mission, we’re not just keeping pace with change—we’re setting the standard. 

As we expand rapidly across the Middle East and Africa, deepen our end-to-end offerings, and push the boundaries of AI, now is the perfect time to join a company that’s growing fast, thinking bold, and delivering real impact.

We have a need for an experienced butcher, who has experience with large animal breakdown - including pork, beef, goat, lamb, deer and reindeer.

Who we are:

Haugen Gardsmat Drift is a meat production company located along the fjord in Flåm, Norway. We are a small company, employing approximately 10 workers. This roll would be in our production facility, mainly assisting the lead butcher in animal breakdown during our busy season from June to December.

Duties:

It is ESSENTIAL that the applicant have good knife skills and experience with large animal breakdown, including deboning. There will be a high volume of animals for the next few months, and the role require someone who can come in, without training, and begin breakdown and be able to perform the heavy labor involved on a daily basis.

Requirements:

To be able to work in Haugen Gardsmat, you must have approved education and work permission in EU/EØS. Experience (3+ years) butchering/breakdown of large animals is required.

Must be willing and able to work with various animal types, including pig, cow, goat, lam, deer and reindeer.

Must be legally authorized to work in Norway.

Must speak and write in English (knowledge of a Scandinavian language is a bonus).

Excellent Knife skills

Basic computer (word, excel, outlook) and math skills

Able to meet the physical demands of manual and traditional meat production (including lifting an carrying heavy loads)

Able to communicate effectively with coworkers and customers

What we provide you:

Salary and benefits will be agreed to if an offer is made and pursuant to Norwegian law.

About Flåm:

Flåm is a small community along the fjords of Western Norway. Although quite small in population, the village is a major tourist sight and cruise port in the summer months and is famous for being part of the Sognfjorden, which has been awarded UNESCO status. The beauty of the mountains, rising straight from the fjords brings countless visitors to the area each year.

The town is approximately 2.5 hours from Bergen and 4.5 hours from Oslo by car.

jobs.occupation: Production Team Member – Premium Salmon Processing (InnovaMar, Frøya)
jobs.description:
SalMar is one of the world’s leading salmon producers — and the most sustainable food producer on the planet  (Global 100, Davos 2026!). With operations across Norway, sales offices in Asia, and a team of over 3,345 people, we turn innovation, passion, and pure Norwegian seawater into world‑class salmon. Want to help shape the future of sustainable seafood? Dive in with us! Head office is located at InnovaMar on Frøya in Trøndelag. 

 

Why Join SalMar?

Become part of a diverse team representing over 40 nationalities. At SalMar, we’re more than a company – we’re a community built on innovation, collaboration, and excellence. Here, you’ll work in a modern facility with access to an on-site gym and cafeteria serving good, nutritious meals, while being part of a global leader in sustainable aquaculture.

If you’re a dedicated team player who values efficiency and strives for outstanding results, this is your chance to shine.

Your Role

As a Production Team Member at InnovaMar, you’ll be at the core of our operations, contributing to the harvesting and processing of premium salmon. Your tasks will include manual cutting, packing, sorting, and preparation. Work shifts alternate between day and evening, offering flexibility and balance.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience in salmon or food production is an advantage, but not required.
• Good communication skills in English or Norwegian.
• Strong team spirit and collaboration skills.
• Ability to provide a valid background check from the Norwegian Civil Aviation Authorities - Clean Criminal records(we assist with info).
• VALID EU PASSPORT OR NORWEGIAN PERMANENT RESIDENCY/ WORK PERMIT (mandatory).
• Driving license is essential – living on Frøya requires personal responsibility for transportation. For permanent relocation, you should have the opportunity to purchase a car.
Personal Qualities

• Reliable and punctual.
• Strong work ethic.
• Flexible and adaptable.
• Responsible and positive attitude.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits.
• A supportive and inclusive work environment.
• Comprehensive pension and insurance agreements.
• Opportunities for long-term employment and growth.
• Access to an on-site gym and a cafeteria serving good, nutritious meals.

Join a workplace that values your well-being, growth, and success.

Ready to make an impact in sustainable seafood production?
 Apply now and join SalMar at InnovaMar, Frøya – where your work makes a difference.

We value diversity and inclusion and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, religion, ethnicity, or other individual differences.

 

Workplace: InnovaMar, Frøya

 

Start date: From 13.04.2026 or by agreement.
